subject: Next steps: Harmony AI evaluation — success metrics & timing
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Arun Gupta <arun@harmony.ai>, Samira Khan <samira@harmony.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Harmony AI evaluation — success metrics & timing

Thanks for the conversation this morning — good to meet the team. Quick post-call recap and a proposed trial success definition so we can land the kickoff and responsibilities. Please review and flag anything you disagree with.

Call summary (quick):
- Goal: validate model quality and unit economics for Harmony AI’s customer-facing summarization pipeline (~512-token outputs).
- Scope: run a 4-week trial against a representative sample of production traffic + 200 curated prompts for human evaluation.

Proposed success criteria (Redwood / Harmony shared):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end generation (512 token equivalent) <= 150 ms for the primary model under the agreed load profile.
- Throughput: sustain 400 inference requests/min (avg) for a 15-minute window without queueing/backpressure.
- Cost: average inference cost <= $0.0018 per token (measured across trial traffic with our accounting profile).
- Quality: human-rated usefulness score >= 85 (scale 0-100) on a 200-sample evaluation set; automated metric baseline (ROUGE/L) reported but not sole gating criteria.

Roles & ownership:
- Harmony: provide representative request logs (sampled), 200 labelled eval prompts, and a test API key for sandbox traffic (team: Arun / Samira).
- Redwood: deliver test harness, instrumented metrics (p50/p95 latency, throughput, cost/token), and weekly reports (team: Ben as SE lead; Evelyn as AE).

Timeline (proposed):
- Mar 3: Harmony shares sample logs + eval set.
- Mar 5: Redwood shares trial harness + onboarding instructions, and a kickoff calendar invite.
- Mar 8: Kickoff + smoke test (provisioning and baseline run).
- Mar 9 — Apr 5: 4-week trial run (data collection + live evaluation).
- Apr 7: Final report + debrief.

Attachments: trial plan spreadsheet (harmony-trial-plan-v1.xlsx) and sample prompts (harmony-eval-sample-prompts.csv) attached for structure and suggested measurement scripts.

Next steps / asks for Harmony:
1) Confirm the proposed latency / cost / quality targets are achievable objectives for your internal stakeholders.
2) Share the sample logs & eval set by Mar 3 (please confirm format).
3) Preferred kickoff window on Mar 8 (we proposed 10am PT) — confirm or suggest alternate.

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben in to finalize the test harness once we have the logs.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0192

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns well with what we discussed. A couple of quick notes from our side: 

- The latency target (p95 <= 150 ms) looks aggressive depending on model variant and quantization; we may need to accept a 170–180 ms p95 for the first baseline run and iterate. Can Redwood include a short run with the quantized variant and report delta?
- Cost target fine as a goal, but please provide per-model cost breakdowns so we can map to our budget buckets.
- We will provide the logs and the 200-sample eval set on Mar 3 — Samira is looping in our infra lead to provision the sandbox API key (should be available same day).

Also: we prefer the kickoff at Mar 8 10am PT — that works for our team.

Thanks,
